title: elaphoglossum yatesii
intro: Elaphoglossum yatesii, commonly known as Yates' Elaphoglossum, is a species of epiphytic fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may aid in reducing inflammation and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Elaphoglossum yatesii include antimicrobial and antifungal effects, which can be used to treat various infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
